New Launch ERA Research · 7 Sep 2026
With New Freehold Launches Becoming Rarer in 2026, Will Buyers Have Enough Choices?
New freehold launches have dropped from 28 projects in 2022 to just 3 in 2026 — but the price premium over leasehold has also collapsed, from 48.2% in 2020 to just 7.1% today. See also my own take on what this means for buyers.
